name: Cocoa Chickpea Brownies
ingredients: 1 cup cooked chickpeas, rinsed and well drained
1 tsp baking powder and 1 tsp vanilla
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C and line a small tin.
Blend the chickpeas, banana, cocoa, oat flour, baking powder, vanilla, soy milk, oil and salt until completely smooth.
Spread in the tin and bake for 22–25 minutes until set.
Cool fully before cutting into 4 squares; they firm as they cool.
note: Chickpeas give protein and fibre; the sweetness comes from banana and a small amount of dark chocolate.
